The default MSDA backend is `reference`; select `--msda-backend cuda-compatible` for the optional [CUDA-compatible route](ascend/MSDA_CUDA.md).

The CUDA-compatible backend completed [VADv2 and HydraMDP in FP32/BF16](ascend/results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json): two updates, full own-checkpoint restoration, DDP4 inference and independent official NAVSIM scoring. Each group used four logical NPUs. The configured official-data subset contains 139 training anchors; these runs consumed the same eight training anchors and evaluated the same 22 held-out anchors. See the [measured commands](ascend/MSDA_CUDA.md#training-own-checkpoint-resume-and-inference).

The [validation report](ascend/FULL_ALGENGINE.md) retains earlier 16-rank/eight-update controls, completed numerical comparisons outside their original tolerances, BF16 gradient-coverage repairs and real-log fine-tuning results. Full NAVTRAIN convergence, full independent benchmark quality, untested synthetic inputs and general numerical reproducibility remain outside completed acceptance. Performance optimization is a separate workstream.

reviewed_scope_claims.text: SimEngine deployment on NPU is outside the assessed scope.

The CUDA-compatible NPU backend completed VADv2 and HydraMDP training, own-checkpoint restoration, independent inference and official CPU scoring in FP32 and BF16. The measured configuration uses four ranks per group and two updates, with eight actual training anchors from the configured NAVTRAIN139 subset and the same 22 held-out evaluation anchors.

Earlier 16-rank, eight-update reference-backend comparisons completed outside their original replay tolerances. Those records remain valid historical limits. The new short functional chain and separate private-candidate two-update positive control do not close longer strict replay, full NAVTRAIN convergence, full NAVTEST quality or untested genuine synthetic-input configurations.

On 17 October 2026, the public `cuda-compatible` MSDA entry completed training, own-checkpoint resume, original DDP4 inference and independent official CPU scoring for VADv2 and HydraMDP in both FP32 and BF16. Four disjoint groups each used four ranks and batch size 1 per rank, giving global batch size 4 per group. Each configuration started from its official 100% planning checkpoint, ran update 1, and resumed its own checkpoint to update 2. Original backbone-freeze settings, geometry, losses, gradient clipping and AdamW were retained. The measured runs explicitly set `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`; FP32 remains the default precision. BF16 used disabled autocast weight caching with actual BF16 Conv/Linear activations and FP32 master weights, participating gradients and Adam state.

The configured training subset contains 139 anchors deterministically derived from the original official data. Each configuration actually consumed 8 distinct current anchors in its two updates; all four configurations consumed the same set, so their union is also 8. History-queue frames are not counted as additional current anchors.

All four branches use the same 22 held-out anchors; these are not 88 independent scenes. Every inference branch exported 22 unique finite 40×3 trajectories with the original vocabulary check. The original NAVSIM scorer independently evaluated genuine official cache payloads: all 22 tokens were valid in each branch, and all seven metrics plus their per-token CSVs are retained. [Complete result and hashes](results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json) provides full-precision metrics, source/input/checkpoint/receipt hashes and the measured scope.

reviewed_scope_claims.text: This page records the default `reference` route and its historical CPU32 target. The optional [CUDA-compatible backend](MSDA_CUDA.md) has a separate target: public MX/MMCV entries pass all 64 complete CUDA tensor comparisons; of 16 CPU32 comparisons, eight pass and eight remain outside tolerance. See the [operator record](results/npu-cuda-msda-20261017.json). These results preserve the historical CPU32 gates; full-model results are separate.

The [October 17 original CUDA baseline](CUDA_BASELINE.md) adds full forward/three-gradient measurements on two normal L1 shapes and original eight-GPU training controls. The CUDA extension itself contains elements outside the unchanged CPU32 gates on these inputs. This does not invalidate the recorded NPU-to-CPU32 results or establish matched-input CUDA/NPU gradient agreement.

`ascend/msda.py` uses NPU-native `grid_sample` forward and first-order backward, with the unchanged MMCV PyTorch reference's `2 * locations - 1`, bilinear sampling, zero padding and `align_corners=False`. Floating inputs, outputs and gradients remain on NPU. Only small integer shape/start metadata moves to CPU. This statement concerns MSDA: the full model also contains an existing CPU fallback for matrix inversion.

The coordinate-only candidate reproduced the old seed but left location-gradient elements outside tolerance in broader cases, so it was not adopted. CPU64 diagnosis did not replace the CPU32 oracle. The acceptance rule remains `abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol * abs(reference)`: forward **2e-5 / 2e-5**, all three gradients **1e-3 / 1e-4**. Every tensor element is compared.

The original `200×200/Q300/H8/C32/seed29` location-gradient case recorded **0/19200** elements outside tolerance, versus the previous 35. Maximum absolute error is **0.001220703125**, accepted by the unchanged combined absolute/relative rule. This is CPU32 agreement, not bitwise equality or measured GPU fused-kernel parity.

The installed SDK forward experiment instead matched a per-query prefix and differed from that CUDA-source interpretation. Therefore preserving the earlier SDK result would preserve a different storage interpretation. The new MMCV compatibility path retains original checkpoint/projection sizes and the inferred CUDA flat prefix. It only accepts actual L1/projected L4, H8/P4/C32 and contiguous floating inputs; other mismatched level counts are rejected. It is selected by this layout structure, not by a module name. Unused raw location/weight tails receive exactly zero gradients. The SDK experiment is a forward-only diagnostic, not a GPU comparison or a complete SDK backward characterization.
| Full encoder shape: Q40000/H8/C32, seeds 29 and 7 | Four normal/legacy cases, 6/6 entry comparisons passed |

The complete checkpoint saved by this run at update 100 was restored on all eight ranks, including **1393 model and 3594 optimizer tensors per rank**, with the same source/data/topology/schedule contract and saved rank RNG. Training reached update **103** with three additional updates on each rank and exit zero. The restored model then completed **37 independent current/history frames**, with **370 finite prediction fields** checked through the original detection/mapping evaluator. These are full-state restoration, continuation and functional inference results. They do not establish strict numerical replay of every subsequent update or trained perception quality.

Separate VADv2/Hydra controls each completed eight continuous updates and resumed their own update-4 checkpoint to update 8, with a deterministic request, B1/workers0 and the same eight-update horizon. Both original numerical gates passed: tensor `atol=1e-6/rtol=1e-5` and loss absolute-difference `<1e-4`. In these specific controls, all **889 VADv2 model / 777 optimizer tensors**, and all **909 Hydra model / 837 optimizer tensors**, were **bitwise equal**. The original comparator reports combined totals of 1668/1748 after also counting two rank-RNG byte tensors; its original fields and values are retained. Maximum tensor and loss differences were zero; batch tokens, learning rates and final saved RNG matched. This is bounded single-rank replay evidence, not a bitwise determinism guarantee for every configuration, seed, batch, distributed topology or training duration. Earlier historical-source numerical failures remain historical evidence.

The October 13, 2026 VADv2/Hydra controls completed four training/restoration jobs and 32 rank runtime checks. Saved-state loading matched, but both final comparisons contained tensors outside the original tolerance: VADv2 had 12 model and 21 optimizer tensors, Hydra had 2 and 2. Batch tokens, LR and final RNG matched; loss differences remained within 1e-4. The [versioned eight-rank record](evidence/eight-rank-resume-20261013-evening.json) preserves thresholds and paths. The cause of full-model divergence remains unconfirmed; fixed-input MSDA agreement does not resolve it.
## Repeat the strict gates on the server

Use an idle logical device and a new output directory. The following mounts source read-only and uses the pinned image; it downloads no data. The full-shape probe invokes the same public validator functions with original H8/C32/Q40000 shapes.
## Repeat CPU replay comparison without changing the comparator

reviewed_scope_claims.text: `--msda-backend cuda-compatible` selects an opt-in FP32 implementation of multi-scale deformable attention (MSDA) for Ascend. It follows the measured coordinate arithmetic and first-order reduction order of the original MMCV 1.6.2 CUDA implementation. It uses native PyTorch NPU operations; floating-point inputs, outputs and gradients remain on the NPU. Small integer spatial metadata is read on the host.
| Spatial axes | Positive integer height and width, each from 1 through 4096 |
| Differentiation | First-order gradients for value, sampling locations and attention weights |

| Public registered entries | Actual DrivingSDK MX and MMCV functions; two full normal-L1 geometries, report `b7054570…` | All 64 CUDA comparisons pass, 32 per entry. Of 16 CPU32 comparisons, eight pass and eight remain outside tolerance. All 80 comparisons completed with unchanged inputs/source/precision/backend and normal release |

| Public MMCV original map layout | Actual registered MMCV six-argument entry; four fixed raw L4 / spatial L1 cases, report `a377773f…` | All 16 CUDA comparisons pass. Of 16 CPU32 comparisons, 14 pass and two remain outside tolerance. All 32 comparisons completed; complete raw gradients are preserved and unused tails are zero. MX raw-L4 remains unsupported |

| Private NPU candidate v8 | Numerical source `264676e4…`; B2/Q40000 and B1/Q65536, both 200×200, H8/C32/P4; four saved CUDA repetitions per case | All 32 complete CUDA tensor comparisons satisfy the original tolerances; saved CPU32 negative comparisons remain separate |

The original CUDA and CPU32 mathematical implementations can choose different boundary arithmetic. Passing the CUDA target does not turn the retained CPU32 negative comparisons into passes. The public-entry report therefore retains a complete-outside verdict and worker exit 1; its guarded controller exited normally with no owned work remaining. Full-model training results are recorded separately. These operator results do not establish full-model replay, cross-platform training equivalence, convergence or performance.

The public [CUDA golden exporter](../tools/validation/README_export_cuda_msda_goldens.md) and [NPU checker](../tools/validation/README_npu_cuda_msda.md) were also executed end to end: a fresh original CUDA export, complete 16-file transfer and both actual public NPU entries. All 64 CUDA tensor comparisons passed; the separate CPU32 target retained eight within tolerance and eight outside. The checker verified all 16 input files before and after execution. Source, backend and original tolerances remained unchanged.

On 17 October 2026, the public `cuda-compatible` MSDA entry completed training, own-checkpoint resume, original DDP4 inference and independent official CPU scoring for VADv2 and HydraMDP in both FP32 and BF16. Four disjoint groups each used four ranks and batch size 1 per rank, giving global batch size 4 per group. Each configuration started from its official 100% planning checkpoint, ran update 1, and resumed its own checkpoint to update 2. Original backbone-freeze settings, geometry, losses, gradient clipping and AdamW were retained. The measured runs explicitly set `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`; FP32 remains the default precision. BF16 used disabled autocast weight caching with actual BF16 Conv/Linear activations and FP32 master weights, participating gradients and Adam state.

The configured training subset contains 139 anchors deterministically derived from the original official data. Each configuration actually consumed 8 distinct current anchors in its two updates; all four configurations consumed the same set, so their union is also 8. History-queue frames are not counted as additional current anchors.

All four branches use the same 22 held-out anchors; these are not 88 independent scenes. Every inference branch exported 22 unique finite 40×3 trajectories with the original vocabulary check. The original NAVSIM scorer independently evaluated genuine official cache payloads: all 22 tokens were valid in each branch, and all seven metrics plus their per-token CSVs are retained. [Complete result and hashes](results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json) provides full-precision metrics, source/input/checkpoint/receipt hashes and the measured scope.
# Use absolute paths. OUTPUT_ROOT must be a new campaign directory.
# Sequential reproduction of each tested four-rank configuration.

Training, full-state resume and inference must select the same `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`. Backend policy, source, image, precision, world size, data and schedule form the resume contract. Old-source or other-backend checkpoints require a new initialization rather than a full-state continuation. Numerical replay against a separately executed continuous control is a separate check; the original tensor `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5` and loss-difference `<1e-4` gates remain unchanged.

reviewed_scope_claims.text: `--msda-backend cuda-compatible` 显式选择 Ascend 上的 FP32 多尺度可变形注意力（MSDA）实现，面向原 MMCV 1.6.2 CUDA 实现已测的坐标运算和一阶归约顺序。它使用原生 PyTorch NPU 运算，浮点输入、输出和梯度保留在 NPU，仅在主机读取少量整数空间元数据。
| 空间轴 | 高度、宽度分别为 1 至 4096 的正整数 |
坐标路径采用 FP32 补偿乘加，不使用 FP64 或浮点 CPU 回退。远距离 padding 及非有限 sampling locations 映射到无效 padding 坐标。该处理不代表支持任意非有限 value、weight 或上游梯度，也不构成通用 IEEE 正确舍入 FMA 或高阶求导保证。value 梯度累加顺序也可能与 CUDA 原子操作不同，应区分容差内一致与逐位相同。
| 私有 NPU 候选 v8 | 数值源码 `264676e4…`；B2/Q40000 与 B1/Q65536，均为 200×200、H8/C32/P4；每例保存 4 次 CUDA 重复结果 | 32 项完整 CUDA 张量比较均在原容差内；保存的 CPU32 超差结果单独保留 |
原 CUDA 与 CPU32 数学实现可能采用不同的边界运算顺序。通过 CUDA 目标不会改变保留的 CPU32 超差结果，因此公版入口报告保留“完整执行但超出原容差”分类，worker 退出码为 1；其守护控制器正常退出且没有遗留自有任务。整模型训练结果单独记录。这些算子结果不构成整模型重放、跨平台训练等价、收敛或性能结论。
## 训练、自身检查点恢复与推理

2026年10月17日，VADv2、HydraMDP 的 FP32/BF16 四组均通过公开 `cuda-compatible` MSDA 入口，实际完成训练、自身 checkpoint 续训、原 DDP4 推理及独立官方 CPU 评分。四个互斥分组各使用 4 个 rank，每 rank batch1，每组全局 batch4。每个配置从原官方 100%规划权重初始化，先完成第 1 次更新，再用自己的 checkpoint 恢复到第 2 次更新。原 backbone 冻结设置、几何计算、损失、梯度裁剪和 AdamW 均保留。实测显式使用 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`，默认精度仍是 FP32。BF16 禁用 autocast 权重缓存，实际记录到 Conv/Linear 的 BF16 激活，以及 FP32 主权重、参与更新的梯度和 Adam 状态。
训练集配置包含从原官方数据确定性派生的 139 个锚点；本轮每组在两次更新中实际消费 8 个不同的当前锚点，四组锚点集合相同，合并后仍为 8 个。历史队列帧未额外算作当前锚点。

四组使用同一批 22 个独立评估锚点，不是 88 个独立场景。每组推理都导出原 22 个唯一 token 对应的 40×3 有限轨迹，并通过原词表检查。原 NAVSIM 评分器使用真实官方 cache payload 独立评分：每组 22 个 token 均有效，完整七项指标和逐 token CSV 均保留。[完整结果与哈希](results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json)给出全精度数值、源代码/输入/checkpoint/收据哈希及实测范围。
# Use absolute paths. OUTPUT_ROOT must be a new campaign directory.
# Sequential reproduction of each tested four-rank configuration.
训练、完整状态恢复和推理必须选择相同的 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`。后端策略、源码、镜像、精度、world size、数据和调度共同构成恢复合同。旧源码或另一后端的检查点不能直接作为完整状态的延续。与独立连续训练的数值重放对照需另行执行，原张量 `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`、loss差 `<1e-4` 的门槛保持不变。

| 私有 NPU 候选 v8 | 数值源码 `264676e4…`；B2/Q40000 与 B1/Q65536，均为 200×200、H8/C32/P4；每例保存 4 次 CUDA 重复结果 | 32 项完整 CUDA 张量比较均在原容差内；保存的 CPU32 超差结果单独保留 |
原 CUDA 与 CPU32 数学实现可能采用不同的边界运算顺序。通过 CUDA 目标不会改变保留的 CPU32 超差结果，因此公版入口报告保留“完整执行但超出原容差”分类，worker 退出码为 1；其守护控制器正常退出且没有遗留自有任务。整模型训练结果单独记录。这些算子结果不构成整模型重放、跨平台训练等价、收敛或性能结论。
## 训练、自身检查点恢复与推理

2026年10月17日，VADv2、HydraMDP 的 FP32/BF16 四组均通过公开 `cuda-compatible` MSDA 入口，实际完成训练、自身 checkpoint 续训、原 DDP4 推理及独立官方 CPU 评分。四个互斥分组各使用 4 个 rank，每 rank batch1，每组全局 batch4。每个配置从原官方 100%规划权重初始化，先完成第 1 次更新，再用自己的 checkpoint 恢复到第 2 次更新。原 backbone 冻结设置、几何计算、损失、梯度裁剪和 AdamW 均保留。实测显式使用 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`，默认精度仍是 FP32。BF16 禁用 autocast 权重缓存，实际记录到 Conv/Linear 的 BF16 激活，以及 FP32 主权重、参与更新的梯度和 Adam 状态。
训练集配置包含从原官方数据确定性派生的 139 个锚点；本轮每组在两次更新中实际消费 8 个不同的当前锚点，四组锚点集合相同，合并后仍为 8 个。历史队列帧未额外算作当前锚点。

四组使用同一批 22 个独立评估锚点，不是 88 个独立场景。每组推理都导出原 22 个唯一 token 对应的 40×3 有限轨迹，并通过原词表检查。原 NAVSIM 评分器使用真实官方 cache payload 独立评分：每组 22 个 token 均有效，完整七项指标和逐 token CSV 均保留。[完整结果与哈希](results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json)给出全精度数值、源代码/输入/checkpoint/收据哈希及实测范围。
# Use absolute paths. OUTPUT_ROOT must be a new campaign directory.
# Sequential reproduction of each tested four-rank configuration.
训练、完整状态恢复和推理必须选择相同的 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`。后端策略、源码、镜像、精度、world size、数据和调度共同构成恢复合同。旧源码或另一后端的检查点不能直接作为完整状态的延续。与独立连续训练的数值重放对照需另行执行，原张量 `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`、loss差 `<1e-4` 的门槛保持不变。

reviewed_scope_claims.text: # FP32 MSDA 实现与数值验证

本页记录默认 `reference` 路径及其历史 CPU32 目标。可选的[CUDA-compatible 后端](MSDA_CUDA_zh.md)使用单独的数值目标：公版 MX/MMCV 注册入口的 64 项完整 CUDA 张量比较通过，16 项 CPU32 比较中 8 项通过、8 项超差，见[算子验证记录](results/npu-cuda-msda-20261017.json)。这些结果不改变历史 CPU32 门槛，整模型结果单独记录。
早期超容差用例 `200×200、Q300、H8、C32、seed29` 的位置梯度超差元素由 **35/19200** 减至 **0/19200**，最大绝对误差为 **0.001220703125**，通过原绝对与相对联合容差。结果未达到逐位相同；该 CPU32 对照本身不能证明 GPU fused 算子对应性。
| 完整 encoder：Q40000/H8/C32，两组 seed | 普通与特殊布局四个用例、6/6 入口比较通过 |
## 858f9d 版本的一小时训练与恢复

从该次训练保存的第 100 步断点恢复时，每 rank 完整复制 **1393 个模型 Tensor、3594 个 optimizer Tensor**，保持源码、数据、拓扑和优化器/LR 契约，恢复各 rank RNG。八 rank 均继续三步至 **第 103 步**并正常退出。恢复后的模型通过原检测/地图评价链路处理 **37 个独立 current/history 帧**，检查 **370 个有限预测字段**。这些结果验证了全状态恢复、继续训练和推理功能，后续每一步的严格数值重放及感知质量还需单独比较。
### 2026 年 10 月 13 日八 rank 数值对照

已安装 SDK 的固定输入前向实验符合逐 query 前缀，与上述 CUDA 源码解释不同。新实现保留原参数、checkpoint 投影尺寸和推断的 CUDA 存储解释，仅在 MMCV 实际 L1/投影 L4、H8/P4/C32、连续浮点输入条件下启用；其他 level 矛盾会被拒绝。实现按布局结构判断，不按模块名称匹配。梯度返回原 L4 形状，未访问尾部精确为零。旧 SDK 诊断仅检查前向，未验证其完整后向或 GPU/NPU 对照。

完整 NAVTRAIN 收敛、八个真实合成配置的完整验收、全图像训练 RAM/I/O/工期、同输入完整张量的 CUDA／NPU MSDA 对照及成对训练／质量验证仍需单独验收。[官方权重 FP32 模型对照](results/gpu-npu-official100-eval22-20261016.json)和[原 CUDA 算子／训练基线](CUDA_BASELINE_zh.md)各有明确范围。[子集工具](data_tools/README_zh.md)另有两个合成配置的小数据结果。本文保留八 rank 超容差记录；当前 16 rank 默认执行和同步候选的结果见[最新实测概况](README_zh.md)。算子通过不构成整套 AlgEngine 正式验收。

reviewed_scope_claims.text: CUDA-compatible NPU 后端已完成 VADv2、HydraMDP 在 FP32/BF16 下的训练、自身检查点恢复、独立推理和官方 CPU 评分。本次每组4个rank、2次更新，实际使用配置NAVTRAIN139子集中的8个训练锚点，评价复用同一22个独立锚点。

2026年10月17日，VADv2、HydraMDP 的 FP32/BF16 四组均通过公开 `cuda-compatible` MSDA 入口，实际完成训练、自身 checkpoint 续训、原 DDP4 推理及独立官方 CPU 评分。四个互斥分组各使用 4 个 rank，每 rank batch1，每组全局 batch4。每个配置从原官方 100%规划权重初始化，先完成第 1 次更新，再用自己的 checkpoint 恢复到第 2 次更新。原 backbone 冻结设置、几何计算、损失、梯度裁剪和 AdamW 均保留。实测显式使用 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`，默认精度仍是 FP32。BF16 禁用 autocast 权重缓存，实际记录到 Conv/Linear 的 BF16 激活，以及 FP32 主权重、参与更新的梯度和 Adam 状态。
训练集配置包含从原官方数据确定性派生的 139 个锚点；本轮每组在两次更新中实际消费 8 个不同的当前锚点，四组锚点集合相同，合并后仍为 8 个。历史队列帧未额外算作当前锚点。

四组使用同一批 22 个独立评估锚点，不是 88 个独立场景。每组推理都导出原 22 个唯一 token 对应的 40×3 有限轨迹，并通过原词表检查。原 NAVSIM 评分器使用真实官方 cache payload 独立评分：每组 22 个 token 均有效，完整七项指标和逐 token CSV 均保留。[完整结果与哈希](results/cuda-compatible-navtrain139-short2-20261017.json)给出全精度数值、源代码/输入/checkpoint/收据哈希及实测范围。
新增可选后端 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible`，以纯NPU FP32补偿采样坐标并计算一阶梯度。真实公开MX／MMCV注册入口在B2/Q40000和B1/Q65536两个完整大形状上，对保存的原CUDA输出与三类梯度共64项完整张量比较全部满足原容差。另16项CPU32比较中，8项满足容差、8项超差，完整负例与CUDA结果分别保留。

## FP32 短周期验证：2026 年 10 月 16 日

两个原100% planning配置均在源码`4ae8ed9f…`/244个Python文件、镜像`3522f3ac…`和NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22上完成：一次冷启动更新、连续0–8次更新、相同8次更新调度下独立运行0–4次、自身检查点恢复4–8次，以及官方初始化/恢复后检查点的22锚点推理和官方CPU评分。保留原backbone冻结配置、8192候选标签；16个逻辑NPU/8张物理卡、B1/global batch16、workers0。
这些是22token测量值，未设质量验收阈值。8次更新仍处于500次warmup内，属于短周期功能证据，不代表收敛或严格重放通过。原8epoch流程继续保留在使用指南中，本结果未完成该流程。证据：[FP32短周期记录](results/fp32-navtrain139-short8-20261016.json)。
## BF16 v7 短周期验证：2026 年 10 月 16 日
关闭权重缓存的v7实现已为两类官方100%配置完成同一NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22短周期链：冷启动1步、连续0–8步、独立运行0–4步、自身检查点恢复4–8步，以及官方初始化/恢复后检查点的22个独立token推理和官方评分。8个训练作业、128份rank运行收据、32份精确恢复收据、4次推理和4次官方CPU评分均完成，无OOM；输入/源码/评分cache哈希未变，自有作业均退出。

这些22token分数未设质量验收阈值。8次更新仍在500次warmup内，不是8个epoch或收敛；BF16继续为显式选择的试验模式。另行进行的37/22真实日志微调不计入本基座结果。证据：[BF16 v7短周期完整记录](results/bf16-v7-navtrain139-short8-20261016.json)、[全rank及保存Adam覆盖验证](results/bf16-v7-gradient-coverage-20261016.json)。

关闭权重缓存的v7实现已为两类官方100%配置完成同一NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22短周期链：冷启动1步、连续0–8步、独立运行0–4步、自身检查点恢复4–8步，以及官方初始化/恢复后检查点的22个独立token推理和官方评分。8个训练作业、128份rank运行收据、32份精确恢复收据、4次推理和4次官方CPU评分均完成，无OOM；输入/源码/评分cache哈希未变，自有作业均退出。

这些22token分数未设质量验收阈值。8次更新仍在500次warmup内，不是8个epoch或收敛；BF16继续为显式选择的试验模式。另行进行的37/22真实日志微调不计入本基座结果。证据：[BF16 v7短周期完整记录](results/bf16-v7-navtrain139-short8-20261016.json)、[全rank及保存Adam覆盖验证](results/bf16-v7-gradient-coverage-20261016.json)。
## BF16 v6 短周期记录：不再作为训练验收依据
两个原 100% planning 配置使用 16 个逻辑 NPU、8 张物理卡，每 rank batch=1、global batch=16、workers=0。输入为从官方数据确定性派生的 NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22 子集和官方 100% planning 初始化权重。保留原 backbone 冻结配置及 8192 候选标签与顺序，并非全参数解冻训练。

# Server host only. Use a fresh input directory for downloads.
# If the official route is unavailable, select this exact-revision mirror instead:

reviewed_scope_claims.text: # AlgEngine on Ascend 910C: installation and usage

For the CUDA-compatible route, pass `--msda-backend cuda-compatible` consistently to training, full-state resume and inference. Omitting it keeps the default `reference`. See the [MSDA backend guide](../ascend/MSDA_CUDA.md) for commands and scope.

WorldEngine contains **AlgEngine**, for model training and evaluation, and **SimEngine**, for rendering, simulation and rollout generation. This guide covers AlgEngine. Existing genuine SimEngine exports can be used as training inputs; deploying its renderer on NPU is outside this guide.
| Prepare the fixed official-data subset | [NAVTRAIN139 / NAVTEST22](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README.md); the alternative NAVTEST-only mini remains in section 3 |

Set these host paths once in the current shell. `DATA` is the directory containing `alg_engine/` and `raw/`, not `data/alg_engine/` itself. Put `WORK` outside the source checkout; all launcher outputs must be new directories.
### Obtain camera images, scene logs and maps
# Relative links remain inside DATA when it is mounted as /data/full.

Use this route for a fixed real-data validation run. The [public preparation tool](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README.md) derives 139 training anchors from an original NAVTRAIN log and 22 evaluation anchors from a separate NAVTEST log. It preserves the original labels and all 8192 PDM candidates. This is a documented derived subset, not an official prepackaged mini or the complete benchmark.
### Prepare the environment, inputs and weights

Download the annotation/PDM groups and official weights with the commands in section 2, including `--group navtrain`. The data tool's [input lock](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/INPUTS.lock.json) gives the six exact URLs, revisions, sizes and hashes. Reuse verified server files. Its two required camera archives are **mini camera 12** and **test camera 30**; a different shard cannot substitute for them. The six original inputs total 47,913,227,335 bytes when none are cached. An [independent official API audit](../ascend/evidence/official-data-origins-20261016.json) matched all six files' pinned revisions, paths, sizes and LFS hashes on 2026-10-16; that metadata query did not download the file payloads. The full camera corpus and SimEngine data are not required.

Run the complete [CPU preparation command](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README.md#run-on-the-linux-server), setting its `OUTPUT_PARENT="$WORK/navtrain139"`. Create that parent first and keep `prepared/` nonexistent. The tool reads the original archives directly, so these two archives do not need a separate extraction. It writes a launcher-ready split and copies only 1832 referenced original JPEGs. Do **not** run `split_mini.py` on this output. Its CPU replay, input hashes, full metadata comparison and image checks are in [VALIDATION.json](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/VALIDATION.json).

Set `VOCAB`, `VAD_BASE_100` and `HYDRA_BASE_100` from section 2. These are official 100%-trained planning initializers. The `--mini-prepared` option below selects the 139/22 validation data; the weight filename does not turn this into full NAVTRAIN training. Maps must be present at `MAPS`.

Select this alternative for native epoch-runner validation. Its checkpoints cannot be exchanged with the eight-update route. Each command uses a new output; continuous, interrupted and resumed runs keep the same eight-epoch horizon.

At 16 ranks and B1, 139 anchors give nine updates per epoch: the continuous and resumed endpoints have 72 updates; the interrupted run stops at 36. This exercises the original epoch runner on a small subset, not convergence over the original 103,288-anchor split. The 256g limit is a subset training allocation and is not suitable evidence for full-data training capacity. This device list describes 16 logical chips on one host; check the physical mapping before using it.

`fp32` is the default and disables both public Matmul/Conv HF32 flags. `bf16` uses native NPU forward autocast with the history/current shared-weight cache disabled; master parameters, gradients, optimizer state, MSDA and planning loss remain FP32, without a loss scaler. Geometry and original BatchNorm/SyncBatchNorm use FP32 islands while retaining original modules, running statistics and collectives. On source `e14dd6b2…`/244 Python files and image `3522…`, both official100 planners completed [eight BF16 updates, own restoration and 22-token inference/scoring on 16 ranks](../ascend/results/bf16-v7-navtrain139-short8-20261016.json). [All-rank and saved-Adam evidence](../ascend/results/bf16-v7-gradient-coverage-20261016.json) verifies restoration of the prior 138 coverage omissions per model. Both complete numerical replays still exceed unchanged original tolerances. Eight updates are within 500 warmup updates, not convergence or quality/numerical equivalence. Set `PRECISION=bf16` to test this opt-in experimental mode with separate outputs and own checkpoints. An FP32 checkpoint cannot resume under a BF16 contract.

The [recorded FP32/BF16 comparison](../ascend/results/fp32-bf16-v7-matched8-planning-20261016.json) covers four model/stage combinations on the same 22 held-out anchors, each with all 40 poses. Same-official-weight inference is separate from each precision's independently trained eight-update checkpoint. These are measurements without a quality-equivalence threshold, not GPU comparisons.

The comparison checks model/optimizer tensors, rank RNG, tokens, LR and losses. Its original tensor tolerance is `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`, and maximum loss difference must be below `1e-4`. The command captures completed comparisons outside the original tolerance (original JSON `result=fail`, exit1, with a complete matching report) so independent inference/scoring can still run; missing or inconsistent reports stop the workflow. Retain an above-tolerance comparison as its numerical result, even when every restoration and training command exited successfully. Do not bypass the source, data, image or precision contract.
### Independent inference and official CPU scoring

Check `inference_validation.json`, the 22-token score and the original comparison JSON independently. The separate [official100 GPU/NPU FP32 comparison](../ascend/results/gpu-npu-official100-eval22-20261016.json) covers these same 22 evaluation anchors; it does not establish full NAVTRAIN convergence, complete NAVTEST quality, GPU training or general 16-rank numerical reproducibility. Current model results are recorded in the [validation report](../ascend/FULL_ALGENGINE.md); environment/data CPU results must not be presented as a model pass.
## 3. Prepare a small real dataset and run eight updates
This is the alternative NAVTEST-only smoke-data path. For genuine NAVTRAIN training anchors and a fixed independent evaluation split, use the recommended NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22 workflow above.
## 4. Train on the original 50% or 100% NAVTRAIN split

Do not apply the separate synchronous eight-update wrapper to a full epoch run. Its [documented protocol](../ascend/execution/README.md) is deliberately limited to the two measured planning configs and eight updates. Four independent repeated pairs completed; two were within the original tolerance and two were outside it. These settings are not an accepted general repair.
## 5. Save and resume complete training state
### x86 CPU scoring of GPU exports
## 7. Evaluate NAVTRAIN and select rare cases

The [October 16 BF16 v7 real-log FT record](../ascend/results/real-log-ft37-bf16-v7-short8-20261016.json) is separate from NAVTRAIN139: both original 37/22 configurations completed eight updates, own update-4 restoration and bitwise replay comparison. That record includes complete VAD evaluation and Hydra inference interrupted at console progress 14/22 before official scoring. A [fresh Hydra completion on October 17](../ascend/results/hydra-ft37-bf16-eval22-20261017.json) used the same own-update-8 checkpoint for all 22 anchors and the original NAVSIM CPU scorer, measuring PDMS 0.9338557270555728; the interrupted run remains recorded. These functional results do not add producer-synthetic coverage or establish convergence.

| Completed comparison outside the original tolerance | Retain the original numerical report and checkpoints. Keep the original thresholds; successful restoration does not establish numerical replay. |

The [validation report](../ascend/FULL_ALGENGINE.md) records the measured conditions, versions and results for small-data training, restoration and scoring. The public rebuild and two 16-rank LoRA fine-tuning workflows have actual small-data evidence. Four independent synchronous base-planner controls completed, with two comparisons outside the original tolerance. Full NAVTRAIN convergence, complete independent NAVTEST results, the other six genuine synthetic configurations and sustained operation in the target environment remain unvalidated.

[All-rank and saved-Adam evidence](../ascend/results/bf16-v7-gradient-coverage-20261016.json) verifies restoration of the prior 138 coverage omissions per model. Both complete numerical replays still exceed unchanged original tolerances. Eight updates are within 500 warmup updates, not convergence or quality/numerical equivalence. Set `PRECISION=bf16` to test this opt-in experimental mode with separate outputs and own checkpoints. An FP32 checkpoint cannot resume under a BF16 contract.

The [recorded FP32/BF16 comparison](../ascend/results/fp32-bf16-v7-matched8-planning-20261016.json) covers four model/stage combinations on the same 22 held-out anchors, each with all 40 poses. Same-official-weight inference is separate from each precision's independently trained eight-update checkpoint. These are measurements without a quality-equivalence threshold, not GPU comparisons.

The comparison checks model/optimizer tensors, rank RNG, tokens, LR and losses. Its original tensor tolerance is `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`, and maximum loss difference must be below `1e-4`. The command captures completed comparisons outside the original tolerance (original JSON `result=fail`, exit1, with a complete matching report) so independent inference/scoring can still run; missing or inconsistent reports stop the workflow. Retain an above-tolerance comparison as its numerical result, even when every restoration and training command exited successfully. Do not bypass the source, data, image or precision contract.

The separate [official100 GPU/NPU FP32 comparison](../ascend/results/gpu-npu-official100-eval22-20261016.json) covers these same 22 evaluation anchors; it does not establish full NAVTRAIN convergence, complete NAVTEST quality, GPU training or general 16-rank numerical reproducibility. ### x86 CPU scoring of GPU exports
## 7. Evaluate NAVTRAIN and select rare cases

The [October 16 BF16 v7 real-log FT record](../ascend/results/real-log-ft37-bf16-v7-short8-20261016.json) is separate from NAVTRAIN139: both original 37/22 configurations completed eight updates, own update-4 restoration and bitwise replay comparison. These functional results do not add producer-synthetic coverage or establish convergence.

| Completed comparison outside the original tolerance | Retain the original numerical report and checkpoints. Keep the original thresholds; successful restoration does not establish numerical replay. |

The [validation report](../ascend/FULL_ALGENGINE.md) records the measured conditions, versions and results for small-data training, restoration and scoring. The public rebuild and two 16-rank LoRA fine-tuning workflows have actual small-data evidence. Four independent synchronous base-planner controls completed, with two comparisons outside the original tolerance. reviewed_scope_claims.text: # AlgEngine 在 Ascend 910C 上的安装与使用
选择 `--msda-backend cuda-compatible` 时，训练、完整状态恢复和推理应保持相同后端；省略该参数则使用默认 `reference`。具体命令及适用范围见[MSDA 后端指南](../ascend/MSDA_CUDA_zh.md)。
| 固定官方数据子集 | [NAVTRAIN139 / NAVTEST22](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README_zh.md)；原 NAVTEST-only mini 路径在第3节保留 |
### 相机图像、场景日志与地图
# Relative links remain inside DATA when it is mounted as /data/full.
固定小数据验证使用[公开准备工具](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README_zh.md)：从原 NAVTRAIN 日志保留139个训练锚点，从另一条 NAVTEST 日志保留22个评价锚点，原标签和8192候选 PDM 保持。这是从官方数据确定性派生的验证子集，不是官方单独发布的标准 mini，也不代表完整基准。
### 准备环境、原始输入和权重

按第2节下载标注、PDM和官方权重，包含 `--group navtrain`。准备器的[输入锁](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/INPUTS.lock.json)列出六个原文件的准确地址、revision、大小和完整哈希，已有文件经校验后直接复用。两个相机包必须是 **mini camera 12** 和 **test camera 30**。无缓存时，六个文件共47,913,227,335字节。[独立官方 API 核验](../ascend/evidence/official-data-origins-20261016.json)于2026-10-16逐项确认六文件的固定 revision、路径、大小和 LFS 哈希；该查询只取元信息，不下载文件内容。无需下载整套相机或 SimEngine 资产。

执行数据工具文档中的[完整 CPU 准备命令](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/README_zh.md#在-linux-服务器执行)，设置 `OUTPUT_PARENT="$WORK/navtrain139"`，先创建父目录，保持其中 `prepared/` 不存在。工具直接读取两个原始相机包，无需先解压；最终只复制1832张实际引用的原 JPEG，并输出 launcher 可直接读取的训练/评价 split。此输出不再调用 `split_mini.py`。原文件哈希、CPU 重建、完整元信息比较与图像检查见[VALIDATION.json](../ascend/data_tools/navtrain139/VALIDATION.json)。
第2节定义的 `VOCAB`、`VAD_BASE_100` 和 `HYDRA_BASE_100` 分别指向官方词表和100%训练的规划基座。下方 `--mini-prepared` 选择139/22验证数据；权重名称不改变训练数据范围。`MAPS` 需指向完整地图目录。
### 原生 epoch 流程：八个 epoch
139个锚点在16 rank、每 rank B1时，每 epoch 为9次更新。连续训练与恢复终点为72次更新，中断分支停在36次。这验证小子集上的原生 epoch 训练流程，不代表原103,288锚点训练集已收敛。256g是此子集的训练内存分配，不能用于推断全量训练容量。设备列表表示同一宿主上的16个逻辑芯片，运行前核对物理卡映射与空闲状态。

默认 `fp32` 关闭公开 Matmul/Conv HF32 开关。`bf16` 使用原生NPU前向autocast并关闭历史/当前帧共享权重缓存，主参数、梯度、优化器状态、MSDA和规划损失保持FP32，不使用loss scaler。几何与原BatchNorm/SyncBatchNorm在FP32岛内计算，保留原模块、运行统计和collectives。源码`e14dd6b2…`/244个Python文件及实测`3522…`镜像下，两类官方100%规划配置均完成[16rank八次BF16更新、自身恢复及独立22token推理/评分](../ascend/results/bf16-v7-navtrain139-short8-20261016.json)。[全部rank和保存的Adam状态](../ascend/results/bf16-v7-gradient-coverage-20261016.json)验证此前每模型138个覆盖缺项恢复，但两组完整数值重放仍超未放宽的原容差。8次更新在500次warmup内，不证明收敛、质量提升或数值等价。测试此显式试验模式时设`PRECISION=bf16`，使用独立输出和自身断点；FP32断点不能按BF16合同继续恢复。
### 独立推理和官方 CPU 评分
## 3. 准备真实小数据，完成单芯片八次更新
这是另一条 NAVTEST-only smoke 数据路径。需要真实 NAVTRAIN 训练锚点和固定独立评价集时，使用上面的 NAVTRAIN139/NAVTEST22 推荐流程。
## 4. 按原 NAVTRAIN 50%／100% 配置训练
## 5. 保存和恢复完整训练状态
## 6. 推理、原评价和独立官方评分
### 在x86 CPU上重算GPU导出的官方评分
## 7. 在 NAVTRAIN 上评价并筛选稀有场景
## 8. 真实日志微调和合成数据配置

[10月16日 BF16 v7 真实日志微调记录](../ascend/results/real-log-ft37-bf16-v7-short8-20261016.json)与 NAVTRAIN139 分开：两个原37/22配置均完成8次更新、自身第4次更新恢复及逐位一致的续训对照。该记录包含完整 VAD 评价，以及在日志进度14/22时中断、尚未评分的 Hydra 推理。[10月17日 Hydra 补充验证](../ascend/results/hydra-ft37-bf16-eval22-20261017.json)使用同一自身第8次更新检查点，重新完成全部22锚点推理及原 NAVSIM CPU 评分，实测 PDMS 为0.9338557270555728；原中断记录继续保留。这些功能结果不增加 producer 合成数据覆盖，也不代表收敛。

CPU32 与原版 CUDA 在部分插值边界存在差异。CUDA 项可以全部在容差内，而 CPU32 项仍使程序返回 1，应查看各目标的独立计数。单纯逐位不同不会触发退出码 1。结果仅覆盖所测算子用例，不构成整模型重放、收敛、质量、性能或其他 NPU 数值差异的根因证明。跨版本使用相同随机种子不代表输入相同，应以完整保存张量的 SHA 为准。
